pairs.why: Both have distressed wood, but A's floor has slightly less peeling and its pumpkin reads a little cleaner and smoother, nearer the real cards' tidy finish.

B adds a chipped, weathered front edge and heavier grain, while A stays a little smoother, closer to the clean wood in the real cards.
